model_competition.scope: external discrete demand-to-actual description only; no physical M/B/K or internal-loop interpretation

train_selection.rule: prefix ending before the documented incomplete third roundtrip begins

model_competition.warning: one-step ARX uses measured past output and is optimistic; free-run and holdout results govern feasibility

interpretive_boundaries: A shared round-start timestamp does not make sequential SDO object reads synchronous.
Manifest estimated_rate_hz is inverse processing time, not actual scheduled round rate.
Position demand is an observed drive-side demand value, not a timestamped Servo Studio command event.
Count-domain results are not traceable physical displacement without external calibration.
Detected phases are demand-moving versus stationary intervals; internal acceleration, current-loop and motion-command event times are unavailable.
Low-order fitted parameters describe the closed commercial loop only and cannot be decomposed into mechanics and internal controller parameters.
